What we would do
We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.

We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
After launch
Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.

sections: Our approach
We would deliver this with Real-Time CDP.
What we would do
We will run use-case workshops, map your entities into profile, event and lookup schemas, and choose the identity namespaces and primary identities the profile will merge on.
We will connect the agreed sources such as CRM, loyalty, commerce and web or app events, map fields to XDM, enable datasets for Profile and check that the first loads build the expected profiles.
We will set the merge method and dataset priority in the default merge policy, review how the identity graph links records, and check sample profiles against source data.
We will set up roles, permissions and development and production sandboxes, apply schema-field usage labels, enable the agreed data usage policies, and confirm activations respect those policies.

lines.name: Implement Brand Concierge
lines.tplAssumptions:
The Client has licensed Brand Concierge and supplies the approved content, current product facts, reviewers and the handoff destination; compliance decisions stay with the Client.

The documented handoff is live chat or meeting booking through Adobe Marketo Qualifier (formerly Sales Qualifier), which needs the representatives added as users in the Adobe Admin Console and at least one representative with a connected calendar (for meeting booking) or set live chat availability (for live chat); a handoff to another chat or contact-center platform is not a documented route and is confirmed with Adobe first.

Live chat and meeting booking don't need Marketo Engage: round robin and direct-agent routing work without it, and it is needed only for custom routing rules, which pick a team by Marketo attributes, and for writing concierge activities to the Marketo person record. Live chat conversations are kept for 30 days, so the Client confirms its own record-keeping needs.

The baseline is the anonymous, public-information experience; profile-based answers are not assumed. Hours scale with the number of products, sources, journeys and test conversations.

These hours cover the partner's work around Adobe's setup: approved sources and reviewers, conversation and disclosure design, the handoff, the golden-answer and refusal tests and the staged rollout.

qualifierInAsksOrSells: The documented handoff is live chat or meeting booking through Adobe Marketo Qualifier (formerly Sales Qualifier), which needs the representatives added as users in the Adobe Admin Console and at least one representative with a connected calendar (for meeting booking) or set live chat availability (for live chat); a handoff to another chat or contact-center platform is not a documented route and is confirmed with Adobe first.

qualifierAnywhereInCatalog.text: Turn on the Brand Concierge flow into Marketo, check that engagement activities and leads from forms, meetings and live chats arrive (meetings and chat need Adobe Marketo Qualifier), and build the Smart Campaigns that score, route and nurture them.

For a human handoff: access to Adobe Marketo Qualifier with representatives added as users. Meeting booking requires a connected calendar and meeting availability; live chat requires configured live chat availability. Marketo Engage is required only for custom routing rules and for Concierge activities written to Marketo person records.

Visitors who fill in a form, book a meeting or start a live chat become Marketo person records, and their concierge engagement is written to those records as activities Smart Campaigns can use; meetings and live chat route through Adobe Marketo Qualifier.
